events.content: The problem was that the entire `ProductPage` was async and awaited `getInventory()` before rendering anything — including the static title. Now the title is outside the `Suspense` boundary and renders immediately, while only the inventory data suspends with a loading fallback. TypeScript check passes cleanly.

part.text: The problem was that the entire `ProductPage` was async and awaited `getInventory()` before rendering anything — including the static title. Now the title is outside the `Suspense` boundary and renders immediately, while only the inventory data suspends with a loading fallback. TypeScript check passes cleanly.
